## Invoicing

- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2/connections-get/): Lists connections to accounting platforms per merchant.
- [v2](https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2/): Copy for LLMView as MarkdownAPI Reference OverviewInvoices v2API v2API v2API v1invoices14 endpointsGETList invoices/v2/invoicing/invoicesLists invoices.POSTCreate draft…
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2/invoices-create): Creates a draft invoice. To move the invoice from a draft to payable state, you must [send the invoice](https://developer.paypal.com#invoices_send).
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2/definitions/invoice_payment_term): The payment term of the invoice. Payment can be due upon receipt, a specified date, or in a set number of days.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2/invoices-send): Sends or schedules an invoice, by ID, to be sent to a customer. The action depends on the invoice issue date:
